newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends off lows on technical buy.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends off lows on technical buy.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Technical support helped prices to close off lows. Trading was volatile with underlying good fundamentals limiting falls. A lower close in Chicago soyoil also eased prices earlier. Nov futures' support seen at 1,230 with resistance at 1,265.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Interest was confined to selected products and nearby crude palm oil. Followed futures trend.
At the close, November futures was five ringgit lower at 1,243 ringgit ($497.99) a tonne after trading between 1,245 and 1,225.
Traders said the next supportive level will be 1,230 with resistance at 1,260.
They added that falls were checked by the underlying firm fundamentals with high exports seen for August.

Dealers attributed the earlier falls to a lower close in Chicago soyoil futures which fell on a bearish input from a Farmers Commodities Corp estimate for U.S. crop production and good crop weather in the U.S. Midwest.
Lack of other fresh tenders also dampened sentiment earlier, they said.
"There was no sign of any tenders this week," a dealer said, adding that, "I don't think they (India or Pakistan) will come into the market as it is almost the end of the week."
Among physicals, interest was among nearby crude palm oil with Sep (south) quoting sellers at 1,255 ringgit a tonne after trading from 1,245 to 1,250. Sep (south) saw bids at 1,250.
Sep (central) was offered at 1,240 with bids at 1,230. Sep (north) saw offers at 1,230 and bids at 1,220.
Oct (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,270 ringgit with bids at 1,260. Oct (central) saw offers at 1,255 and bids at 1,245 and Nov (south) at 1,275 with bids at 1,265.
In refined products, Sep RBD palm oil was offered at $537.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Oct/Nov/Dec at $537.50.

Sep palm olein saw offers at $580, Oct at $572.50 and Nov/Dec at $562.50. Sep RBD pam stearin was offered at $425 and Oct at $430. Sep/Oct/Nov palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $340. --Tan Lee Lee (603-2308911) ($1=2.4960 ringgit)
